analysis_name: SAEPS post-hoc exact fixed-state curvature decomposition v1

bug.description: The exact-error identity combined the historical selected LSQR F_SAEPS value on its left side with the explicit Schur C_relax_GN value on its right side. The two implementations passed their direct consistency tolerance, but the mixed identity residual could fail after cancellation and incorrectly change analysis_valid.

required_next_action: Use a separately frozen and authorized v2 protocol; do not modify or resume v1.
